args.sql: CREATE VIEW vw_panel_efficiency AS SELECT p.panemark, per.perfregistry, ROUND(CAST(per.measpoww / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * 100 AS numeric), 2) AS ppr, ROUND(CAST(p.powratew * p.tempcoef * (e.celltempc - 25) AS numeric), 2) AS tpci, ROUND(CAST((per.measpoww / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric) * 100) + ((p.powratew * p.tempcoef * (e.celltempc - 25)) / CAST(p.powratew AS numeric)) AS numeric), 2) AS tapr FROM panel p JOIN performance per ON p.panemark = per.solmodref JOIN environment e ON per.perfregistry = e.envregistry;
